en.description:
Foldlings is a merge-elements game where every creature is sketched in ink. You start with four things: Water, Fire, Earth and Air. Combine two and discover what they make. Everything else, you find yourself.

Hold one, add another, and press them together. Drag one little creature onto the other, or flip your phone face-down and the two halves of the screen fold shut like a book. Pick it up and see what you made. The first time Water meets Fire and turns into Steam, it feels like a small magic trick. It keeps going from there: Ice and Air make Snow, Snow and Snow make a Snowman, a Plant in the Sun becomes a Flower.

• 100 things to find, all from nature: weather, water, earth, ice and snow, the night sky, the shore, plants, and the animals that live among them
• Every one is sketched in ink, with color that slips past the line, and each has its own way of being: the Cactus waves, Snow tumbles as it falls, the Snowman's head has slipped a little. The lines wobble like a sketch that's still alive. It blinks, it looks delighted when it's new and puzzled when nothing happens
• Press two together and you see them squash flat before the new one appears
• You're never stuck. Hints start from whatever you're holding, sparkles show which elements still have something to give, and when one has made all it can, the game tells you what to pick up next
• The Almanac fills in as you go, and shows what you're ready to make
• With Apple Intelligence turned on, a hint can arrive as a little clue from nature, and each discovery gets a short note about the real thing. It's written on your device and nothing leaves it
• Ask Siri for a hint, what's in your hand, or how many you've found
• iPhone, iPad and an Apple Watch app that keeps your discoveries in sync

No timers, no ads, no accounts, nothing to buy. Just a sketchbook that fills in a little more every time you press two things together.

Made by one person who wanted a calm game to play before bed. If you find a combination you think should exist, write to me from the support page.
en.releaseNotes:
Seasonal creatures to find while a season is on. Free, like everything else in the game. Halloween, 24 Oct to 2 Nov, brings six.
Diwali, 5 to 9 Nov, follows with two.
Found seasonal creatures stay in your Almanac.
Ask Siri what you can discover this week.
en.subtitle: Discover Elements in Calm Ink

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
All 58 creatures have been redrawn as folded paper. Each one is a single sheet, cut and folded once, with its own silhouette and a face that sits where it naturally would.

Pressing two creatures together now shows them folding flat before the new one appears.

Also new: the game is localized for Mexican Spanish and for English in the UK, Australia and Canada.

42 new creatures to find, 100 in all: the night sky, the shore, caves and waterfalls, and the small animals of the forest floor.

Every creature has been redrawn as an ink sketch with color, each with its own gesture and character.

More ways to mix: lots of things can now be made more than one way.

Updated App Store pages and screenshots.
Built with Xcode 27.1.
